notes: Every published demo passed the current strict visual-alignment gate at export time.
Each hotspot must have a LocateAnything or MiMo primary source plus SAM mask, cutout, organic preview, and expanded organic bounds.
Cases that fail the current gate are skipped instead of being refreshed into the public showcase.

demos.title: West Lake hand-drawn tour map
demos.question: Create a hand-drawn West Lake tour map as one coherent landscape image. Do not draw numbered pins, a right-side attraction list, or pre-split region borders. Let users click natural scenic areas to inspect their travel value.

demos.title: Li Bai and Shakespeare comparison
demos.question: Create a refined illustrated comparison scene between Li Bai and William Shakespeare. Li Bai was a Tang dynasty Chinese poet, 701-762. William Shakespeare was an English poet and playwright, 1564-1616. The only clickable targets are Li Bai, Moonlit Mountains, Wine Cup and Travel Scroll, Shakespeare, Theatre and Manuscript, and Shared Literary Legacy. Each clickable target should explain its factual role, literary theme, and why the visual comparison is meaningful without inventing false historical contact.

demos.title: Zhejiang University Yuquan campus map
demos.question: Create a refined hand-drawn orientation map of Zhejiang University Yuquan Campus. Fact anchors: Yuquan Campus is at 38 Zheda Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou; it is within walking distance of West Lake and Hangzhou Botanical Garden; it backs onto Laohe Mountain. The only clickable regions are Zheda Road 38 Entrance, Campus Main Walk, Teaching and Engineering Buildings, Yuquan Library, Hangzhou Botanical Garden Edge, and Laohe Mountain Green Backdrop. Explain orientation, campus use, and visiting or study context for each region. Do not invent specific building names, false gate names, exact street geometry, or a precise floor-plan-style campus layout.

demos.title: Transformer development timeline
demos.question: Create a refined academic poster timeline of Transformer-based language model development. The only clickable milestones are 2017 Transformer, 2018 GPT, 2018 BERT, 2019 GPT-2, 2020 GPT-3, and 2022 ChatGPT. Each clickable milestone should explain the technical contribution, model family relationship, and why it matters in the development loop from architecture to pretraining, scaling, instruction tuning, and interactive use.

demos.title: Healthy breakfast options
demos.originalTitle: 一组健康早餐选择的插画场景
demos.question: Create an illustrated healthy breakfast options scene. Naturally show oatmeal bowl, Greek yogurt cup, whole-grain sandwich, boiled egg plate, fresh fruit, and black coffee. Let users click each food to inspect nutrition and best-fit breakfast scenarios.
